en_title: GTA 6 Was Almost Refused a Rating in South Korea Due to 'Genital Nudity'
cn_title: 《GTA6》因「生殖器裸露」差点在韩国遭拒绝分级
opus_summary: 《GTA6》在韩国申请评级时，委员会因游戏中缺乏性情境的男性裸露内容产生分歧，首次投票结果为三票拒绝评级、三票给予成人专用评级。审查可游玩版本后，委员会以八票赞成、一票反对的结果通过成人专用评级。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 was almost too much for South Korean ratings board GCRB, who struggled to agree whether the game should be approved or not. The board cited “out of context genital nudity” as the sticking point.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》差点让韩国分级机构GCRB难以接受，该机构难以就是否批准这款游戏达成一致。委员会指出，「脱离语境的生殖器裸露」是症结所在。

paragraphs.en: Rockstar sent an application for a South Korean rating on September 1. The initial vote, held on September 10, ended in a tie, with three votes for classification refusal and three for an Adults Only rating.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar于9月1日提交了韩国分级申请。9月10日举行的首次投票以平局告终，三票赞成拒绝分级，三票赞成评为仅限成人级。

paragraphs.en: InvenGlobal acquired the meeting minutes from the voting sessions, where some board members argued for classification refusal over in-game nudity. When voting resulted in a tie, they chose to postpone the decision while awaiting a playable build of the game.
paragraphs.cn: InvenGlobal获取了投票会议的会议记录，记录显示，一些委员会成员因游戏内的裸露内容主张拒绝分级。投票出现平局后，他们选择推迟决定，等待游戏的可玩版本。

paragraphs.en: A GTA 6 build was delivered to the committee on September 28 and an initial revisit of the board was postponed twice for a more "sufficient gameplay examination.” That’s one way to get to play it early.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》的一个版本于9月28日交付委员会，委员会原定的首次重新审查则为了更「充分地检查游戏内容」而两度推迟。这倒是一种提前玩到游戏的方式。

paragraphs.en: After being initially pushed from October 2 to October 8, it was pushed once more and the committee met again on October 18. The second review passed a vote for an Adults Only rating with eight voting in favor of the rating and one voting against classification.
paragraphs.cn: 重新审查最初从10月2日推迟至10月8日，随后又推迟了一次，委员会于10月18日再次开会。第二次审查通过投票，将游戏评为仅限成人级，其中八票赞成该分级，一票反对分级。

paragraphs.en: The content descriptors were assigned as “Sensuality, Violence, Crime, Drugs, and Language.” That first one, “Sensuality,” was the issue.
paragraphs.cn: 游戏被标注的内容描述为「色情、暴力、犯罪、毒品和语言」。第一个描述「色情」就是问题所在。

paragraphs.en: According to the report, the committee took particular issue with male nudity without any sexual context. The South Korean ratings board revised its regulation rules in September 2025, but previously even a suggestion of nudity could land a game with an Adults Only rating.
paragraphs.cn: 据报道，委员会尤其对没有任何性语境的男性裸露内容有异议。韩国分级机构于2025年9月修订了监管规则，但在此前，即便只是暗示裸露，也可能让一款游戏被评为仅限成人级。

paragraphs.en: After the revision, this wording changed to "cases where suggestive bodily exposure is directly and specifically depicted." GTA 6 was the first game to run into the new, apparently more relaxed, rules. No such rules exist for crime or drug depictions.
paragraphs.cn: 修订后，相关措辞改为「直接且具体地描绘带有暗示性的身体暴露的情形」。《GTA6》是首款遇上这套新规则的游戏，新规则显然更加宽松。对于犯罪或毒品的描绘，则不存在此类规则。

paragraphs.en: A rating refusal would have blocked the release of GTA 6 in South Korea entirely. According to the report, the ratings board felt pressure with potentially being the sole country to refuse classification to the biggest game of the year.
paragraphs.cn: 拒绝分级将彻底阻止《GTA6》在韩国发行。据报道，分级机构感到了压力，因为韩国可能成为唯一一个拒绝为这款年度最大游戏分级的国家。

paragraphs.en: Last month, GTA 6 received an age rating of PEGI 18 , which included mentions of "decapitation," the ability for players to snort cocaine at any time, "scenes of sexual fetishes," and much more. The rating, since deleted, described GTA 6's violence as "bloody with a high degree of realism." Some weapons will be more brutal than others, with some said to be "able to cause greater damage, such as detailed decapitation and dismemberment." Rockstar has made drug use "frequent and prominent," with players able to partake in illicit substances. Cocaine is said to be especially important in Vice City, with the rating promising that Jason and Lucia will be able to use the substance directly from their inventory, as it can be "snorted directly from their hand at any time."
paragraphs.cn: 上个月，《GTA6》获得了PEGI 18年龄分级，分级说明提到了「斩首」、玩家能够随时吸食可卡因、「性癖场景」及更多内容。这份现已删除的分级说明将《GTA6》的暴力内容描述为「血腥且高度写实」。有些武器会比其他武器更加残酷，据称有些武器「能够造成更严重的伤害，例如细致呈现的斩首和肢解」。Rockstar让毒品使用变得「频繁且突出」，玩家可以使用违禁物质。据称，可卡因在Vice City尤其重要，分级说明表示Jason和Lucia能够直接从物品栏中使用这种物质，因为它可以「随时直接从手上吸食」。

paragraphs.en: The GTA 6 PEGI description also touched on " strong sexual themes ," which include "nudity, scenes of intercourse, and occasional scenes of sexual fetishes." None of this should come as much of a surprise, given the GTA 6 launch trailer teases steamy shower scenes between Jason and Lucia .
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》的PEGI分级说明还提到了「强烈的性主题」，其中包括「裸露、性交场景以及偶尔出现的性癖场景」。鉴于《GTA6》的发布预告片预示了Jason和Lucia之间火辣的淋浴场景，这些内容应该都不会让人太过意外。

paragraphs.en: Not long now: GTA 6 is out on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. IGN's latest coverage includes speculation about a potential beloved legacy character from a previous game hiding in the latest GTA 6 trailer , and the release of new GTA 6 footage that looks so real fans actually thought it was real-life .
paragraphs.cn: 现在已经不用等太久了：《GTA6》将于11月19日登陆PS5和XBOX Series X及S。IGN的最新报道包括关于《GTA6》最新预告片中可能藏有一位来自前作、深受喜爱的经典角色的猜测，以及新发布的《GTA6》画面；这些画面看起来如此逼真，以至于粉丝真的以为那是现实生活。
